title: THE CITY CAN WAIT - director's cut (9:16, 24 fps, 2160x3840)
concept: A film about time. Outside, the city races: speed-ramped timelapse, a ticking clock that doubles and doubles again, a pipe organ ostinato that builds. Then time STOPS. Inside, the coffee ritual happens in slow motion; the organ swells into a warm climax as the coffee meets the cup. At the end the city waits outside the window, the clock slows, one last tick, black. Interstellar is the reference for the score (pipe organ, minimalist ostinato, ticking clock, slow build), never its melodies.
clock: the clock motif ticks on whole seconds unless stated: base pulse 60 bpm (1 tick per second)
